summary_1line: Yajnavalkya explains cosmic dissolution into higher principles and outlines the triadic relation of body, function, and deity, followed by the qualities of the three gunas.

image_candidates.scene_text: Maharudra as a blazing sun of countless rays divides into fiery forms and burns all creatures until the Earth lies bare like a tortoise shell.
After the world burns, Rudra floods the empty Earth with immense waters that later evaporate in a vast cosmic fire.
The universe dissolves step by step as fire is swallowed by wind, wind by space, space by mind, and all finally absorbed into the supreme luminous being.
